payload.explanation: All four parts (u_brown, u_orange, line_green, inverted_u_yellow) ended seated against their LIVE placement frames within registry position and orientation tolerances (errors 2.1/2.0/6.6/1.5 mm; <=0.8 deg). Each was gripped at its step's grasp_width_m (within grasp_width_tolerance_m 0.02), lifted >=0.2 m, and held with no slip (grasp_slip_tolerance_m monitors per part, none fired) and no clamp-effort exceedance (max_clamp_effort monitors per part, none fired; peak sampled finger_joint effort ~72 vs 250 for inverted_u_yellow). Stationarity monitors on bystanders u_green, inverted_u_brown, hex_blue, hex_red (disturbance_tolerance_m 0.02) never fired and their end-of-run displacement is sub-mm; inactive and seated own parts were monitored the same way with no fire. No findings (record_verdict) were recorded because no violation was found. Not watchable against a spec bound: base1 and base2 have no registry spec block, so their stationarity had only agent-chosen 5 mm observation triggers; base2 never moved; base1 shifted ~3.0 mm / 0.3 deg cumulatively through seating contacts (obs-001, impact unknown, no tolerance to judge). Observations: obs-002 an unlisted pale elongated object (beam or possibly a person's forearm) entered over inverted_u_brown around 23:18:41Z and was gone by look 0004 -- no bystander moved (resolved); obs-003 an unlisted red cube appeared near (0.10,-0.38) and is still present, untouched. Monitor housekeeping: the first workspace camera monitor fired on the arm's own elbow (look 0002) and was judged mis-armed (no verdict) and re-armed with a wider arm corridor. Execution note: place_approach_u_orange carried no target_offset in the steps block; I used an agent-chosen 0.05 m standoff (mirroring u_brown) to honour 'stop clear of contact' -- an intermediate execution choice that does not affect the end-state.
